messages:
anya: Quick prototype dropped - compact left rail that groups similar console pages into two rollups: 'Workflows' and 'Data'. Trying to avoid breaking deep links.

kevin: Love the cleaner look. Important: preserve /models/:id and /models/:id/versions deep links.

leo: If we rename anchors, implement a router alias layer so old links map to new canonical paths. No visible 302 for users.

alix: UX note: when mapping an old link show a subtle, dismissible toast: "Mapped from legacy console path. Learn more." Make sure it's aria-live polite.

anya: Proposed alias header: x-redwood-canonical: /workflows/deploys. Client should replaceState with canonical path.

kevin: Use replaceState not pushState so back button remains intuitive. Also keep query params intact (utm, modal flags).

leo: Ops point: bookmarks/pins must migrate. Recommend a dry-run job to detect pins pointing at aliases and produce CSV for review.

alix: Accessibility checklist: breadcrumb in <nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs">, toast role=status, leftnav buttons have aria-expanded and keyboard focus styles.

ops-bot: Reminder: design review Thurs 2pm. Bring Figma + alias CSV.

anya: I'll upload Figma and small mapping table today. Kevin/Leo, can you review the router middleware PR?

kevin: I can. I'll validate replaceState usage and header semantics.

leo: I'll own the migration dry-run and telemetry for alias_resolved events.
